footer.line: Integrated Pastoral Management and Analytics System

hero.subhead: SIGAP turns your census, attendance and committees into population pyramids, spiritual life-cycle tracking and growth projections — with the same clarity for the local pastor, the district leader and national leadership.
hero.trust: Private access by invitation and authorized profile.

rollup.caption: One data point, rolled all the way up
rollup.nacionalDesc: A read on the whole country

modules.text1: Census, families and each person's spiritual life cycle, from the day they join to the role they hold.
modules.text2: Population pyramid, growth projection and a health traffic-light — the same at the local, district and national level.
modules.text3: Evangelism, Youth Mission and the 10 committees, consolidated at every level.

plans.title: The same complete SIGAP, at whatever pace works for your congregation.
plans.subtext: No trimmed-down features or a "basic version" — the difference between plans is the commitment period, not what you can do with the system. Message us and we'll advise you on the exact price for your congregation's size.
plans.monthlySummary: To get started with no strings attached, and see the change from your very first month-end close.
plans.monthlyBenefit1: Full access to every module, with no features locked.
plans.monthlyBenefit2: Your congregation is up and running on SIGAP in days, not months.
plans.monthlyBenefit3: Adjust or cancel whenever you need to.
plans.annualSummary: For the congregation that has already decided SIGAP is how it works, all year round.
plans.annualBenefit1: Same full access, with a better total cost across the year.
plans.annualBenefit2: Ongoing support through every quarter of growth.
plans.annualBenefit3: Priority support and early access to new features.
plans.trust: We'll reply on WhatsApp with the price based on the number of congregations and districts you need to manage.
